$comment: Government-services Phase 2 supplement (2026-10-07): verbatim passages from CRAWLED/VERIFIED agency pages that the software-tuned extraction pass starves out — statutory fees, identity/credential walls, foreign-founder paths, sanctioned software channels, fallback rails. Same contract as the Phase 1 seed (government-services-supp-evidence.json): every item's `quote` must be a verbatim substring of the cached crawl page mapped from its `url`; the append script verifies all quotes and refuses to write on the first mismatch. The `quote` is verification-only and is not written to evidence.

companies-house.quote: Companies House digitally records almost all information it receives, and makes this available to the public through its own website and through the Companies House RESTful API. Being RESTful, each record of information is assigned a globally unique URI
companies-house.excerpt: The register is machine-readable by design: "Companies House digitally records almost all information it receives, and makes this available to the public through its own website and through the Companies House RESTful API." The developer suite publishes dedicated Authorisation, Rate limiting and API versioning guides alongside it.

companies-house.quote: We have a proposed approach to versioning the API and documentation
companies-house.excerpt: Versioning posture is published and candid: the API is at beta, "We have a proposed approach to versioning the API and documentation", with existing resources explicitly held 'as is' as version 0 while the approach is discussed in the public Developer Hub Forum.

companies-house.quote: verify your identity for Companies House
companies-house.excerpt: An identity-verification wall is rolling across the register's write paths: the agency's own news page carries guidance on "when you need to verify your identity for Companies House", including identity verification details for people with significant control (PSC).

companies-house.quote: We hold the UK’s register of companies and the Register of Overseas Entities.
companies-house.excerpt: Non-UK founders are inside the service's own scope statement: "We hold the UK’s register of companies and the Register of Overseas Entities."

hmrc.quote: your total taxable turnover for the last 12 months goes over £90,000
hmrc.excerpt: Registration thresholds are published as exact figures: you must register for VAT when "your total taxable turnover for the last 12 months goes over £90,000", and voluntary registration below the threshold is stated on the same page.

hmrc.quote: You will then be able to manage your Corporation Tax online.
hmrc.excerpt: The core corporation-tax rail is online through the business tax account: register, add Corporation Tax services, and "You will then be able to manage your Corporation Tax online."

hmrc.quote: software that works with Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
hmrc.excerpt: Making Tax Digital is a sanctioned software channel stated on the sign-up page itself: filing runs through "software that works with Making Tax Digital for Income Tax", with the software-provider check called out before sign-up.

hmrc.quote: If you use an agent, they can sign you up instead.
hmrc.excerpt: The delegated rail is one published sentence: "If you use an agent, they can sign you up instead." — agents hold their own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links.

uk-ipo.quote: Registering a trade mark costs at least £205.
uk-ipo.excerpt: Statutory fees are exact and on-page: "Registering a trade mark costs at least £205." A trade mark lasts 10 years and renewal cadence is stated alongside.

uk-ipo.quote: You’ll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up.
uk-ipo.excerpt: The identity wall on the patent filing path is a credential account, stated before you start: "You’ll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up."
A paper fallback rail is published on the same page ("If you cannot file online" — fill in the request form for grant of a patent), so the online mandate has a documented alternative.

uk-visas-immigration.quote: It costs £1,357 per person if you apply outside the UK.
uk-visas-immigration.excerpt: Founder-visa fees are exact and split by filing location: "It costs £1,357 per person if you apply outside the UK." and £1,693 to extend or switch inside the UK.
The core transaction is online by mandate: "You must apply online." — the Innovator Founder route's application path is stated with separate in-country and out-of-country flows.

uk-visas-immigration.quote: Visa processing times: applications outside the UK
uk-visas-immigration.excerpt: Processing times are a first-class published surface ("Visa processing times: applications outside the UK"), maintained with dated change notes and a service that tells applicants when to expect a decision.

ip-india.excerpt: The office runs a dedicated e-services layer: "Comprehensive e-Filing Services" sits beside Track Status, Dynamic Utilities, Cause List and Controller's Decision in the patents navigation — an online filing and status rail.
Public status lookup is linked from the office's own pages: "Track Status" resolves to the public application-status search on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in, no account named on the entry.
Official fees are published as the statutory First Schedule with downloadable forms on the "Forms & Official Fees" page — amounts by filing mode, not a contact form.

handelsregister.quote: Auf dieser Seite finden Sie die Handels-, Genossenschafts- , Partnerschafts-, Gesellschaftsregister sowie die Vereinsregister aller Bundesländer und darüber hinaus die Registerbekanntmachungen (Veröffentlichungen).
handelsregister.excerpt: One national reading surface for every state register: "Auf dieser Seite finden Sie die Handels-, Genossenschafts-, Partnerschafts-, Gesellschaftsregister sowie die Vereinsregister aller Bundesländer und darüber hinaus die Registerbekanntmachungen." — register search and announcements are public.

handelsregister.quote: Aktuell kommt es durch hohe Abrufzahlen im Registerportal wiederholt zu Überlastungen einzelner Bundesländer und als Folge davon zur temporären Nichtverfügbarkeit bei Abrufen von Daten aus diesen Ländern.
handelsregister.excerpt: The portal publishes its own load limits as live status notes: repeated overload from high retrieval volumes makes individual states' data temporarily unavailable — an operating-window reality stated on the front page.

elster.quote: ist eine kostenlose und einmalige Registrierung in Mein ELSTER notwendig. Sie erhalten ein Zertifikat, mit dem Sie Ihre Steuererklärung ohne
elster.excerpt: The identity wall is a free one-time registration that issues an electronic certificate: "Für eine papierlose Abgabe ... ist eine kostenlose und einmalige Registrierung in Mein ELSTER notwendig. Sie erhalten ein Zertifikat, mit dem Sie Ihre Steuererklärung ohne Unterschrift elektronisch versenden können." — a credential, not biometric liveness.

elster.quote: Sie können aber auch jede andere Steuersoftware verwenden, die ELSTER unterstützt.
elster.excerpt: The sanctioned software channel is explicit: "Sie können aber auch jede andere Steuersoftware verwenden, die ELSTER unterstützt." — any tax software that supports ELSTER transmits through the same rail, and authenticated transmission is supported by most commercial products per the same page.

elster.quote: Wirtschaftlich handelnde Organisationen aller Art können sich mit Hilfe ihrer ELSTER-Zertifikate bei Online\-Diensten anmelden, Anträge authentifiziert ausfüllen und absenden.
elster.excerpt: The ELSTER certificate doubles as the business sign-in for government online services (Mein Unternehmenskonto): organisations authenticate, fill and submit applications with the same certificate.

inpi-guichet-unique.quote: Pour signer le dépôt d’actes sur le Guichet unique, il convient de vous munir d’un certificat de signature électronique avancée reposant sur un certificat qualifié fourni par un organisme de certification
inpi-guichet-unique.excerpt: The signing wall is a qualified e-signature certificate: "Pour signer le dépôt d’actes sur le Guichet unique, il convient de vous munir d’un certificat de signature électronique avancée reposant sur un certificat qualifié" — a credential issued by a certification body, stated before filing.

The Guichet unique is the single mandatory window for company formalities (creations, modifications, cessations, annual accounts) replacing the six former CFE networks under the loi Pacte, accessible free of charge per the access page.

irn-portugal.quote: Escolha um meio de autenticação: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, Certificado Digital de Profissional Jurídico, Autenticação Europeia (eIDAS)
irn-portugal.excerpt: The authentication menu is published up front: "Escolha um meio de autenticação: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, Certificado Digital de Profissional Jurídico, Autenticação Europeia (eIDAS)" — national ID card, mobile key, professional certificate, or EU eIDAS.

A foreign-founder path is a named user class on the service page: "Cidadão estrangeiro" — with the Chave Móvel Digital tied to a passport or European eIDAS authentication as the stated route into Empresa Online.

Statutory fees are exact on the service page: 220,00 euros for a standard online incorporation with a pre-approved pact (440,00 urgent), 360,00 euros with a founder-drafted pact (720,00 urgent), with a 48-hour payment window after submission.

corporations-canada.quote: It will cost **$200** and will take **1 day.**
corporations-canada.excerpt: Fees, channel and clock are published together: online incorporation "will cost $200 and will take 1 day", plus $100 for 4-hour express service — against $250 and 10 days by email or mail with the PDF form.
The core transaction is an online rail ("Go to Online Filing Centre"), with the paper PDF channel documented alongside as the explicit fallback — both rails on one page.

cra.excerpt: The non-resident path is a first-class published fork: the business-registration page points "Register as a non-resident" founders to their own program-account route, including registering "a Canadian business with only non-resident owners".

cra.quote: Registering online is the fastest and easiest way to get a business number (BN)
cra.excerpt: The core transaction is online by the agency's own framing: "Registering online is the fastest and easiest way to get a business number (BN)" and certain program accounts in one flow.

The sanctioned software-transmitter channel is EFILE: certified software plus an enrolled electronic filer transmit returns system-to-system, with the enrollment path published on the agency's own pages.

cipo.excerpt: Online services are the stated front door: "Apply for/amend a trademark" sits under an Online services block on the office's own trademarks page, alongside opposition and release-note pages for the filing system.
The patents rail runs through an account: "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" is the published entry, with public patent search available keylessly beside it.

ircc.quote: We calculate them by checking how long it took us to process 80% of that type of application in the past
ircc.excerpt: Processing times are published with their method: "We calculate them by checking how long it took us to process 80% of that type of application in the past" — backwards-looking times per application type, in a public checker.

A founder-specific immigration product exists as its own published program: the "Start-up Visa Program" page documents the route for entrepreneurs immigrating to build a business in Canada — by definition a non-resident founder path.

new-jersey-dor.quote: setting up a Premier Business Services (PBS) account
new-jersey-dor.excerpt: The account layer is named with help published for it: filings, certifications and apostilles run with "setting up a Premier Business Services (PBS) account" covered by the division's own step-by-step videos.

new-jersey-dor.quote: Search online to receive a Standing Certificate for an LLC, LLP, LP, Corporation or Non-profit organization in New Jersey
new-jersey-dor.excerpt: Public status products are online: "Search online to receive a Standing Certificate for an LLC, LLP, LP, Corporation or Non-Profit" — business records and standing certificates without a counter visit.

ohio-sos.quote: When you log in with OHID, your privacy, data, and personal information are protected by federal and stat
ohio-sos.excerpt: The state's one-stop runs on a single credential account: "Trusted applications are secured by OHID" — the Ohio Business Gateway's stated sign-in layer for business filings, with the identity protections described on the landing page.

minnesota-sos.excerpt: The filing portal's published entry is a credential account ("Sign In" / "Create an Account") — an online rail behind a standard login, stated on the Business & Liens home page.

washington-sos.quote: This location provides same-day service only. We charge a $150 same-day service
washington-sos.excerpt: In-person fallback exists with its price published: the corporations counter "provides same-day service only. We charge a $150 same-day service fee and record all visits to public record."
